ideas.pitch: An enterprise AI agent that analyzes health insurance claim rejections, compares them against the insurer's policy documents, and automatically generates legally sound appeal arguments.
ideas.title: AegisPolicy: Insurance Denial Appeal Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Medicine track while matching a proven winning pattern of building domain-specific reasoning agents against document corpora.

ideas.pitch: An automated anti-money laundering risk detection platform that combines transaction graph intelligence with explainable machine learning models to flag illicit fund movements.
ideas.title: GraphAML: Crypto Transaction Risk Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Finance track perfectly by addressing compliance and transaction risk, echoing the exact success pattern of graph-based AML detection platforms.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent aviation system that processes weather patterns, restricted airspace data, and telemetry feeds to dynamically optimize and safety-check drone delivery routes.
ideas.title: AeroRoute: Drone Flight Path Risk Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the specialized Drone Tech & Aviation track means facing significantly less competition than general open innovation tracks.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered security log parser that aggregates multi-source infrastructure telemetry and correlates anomalies to generate actionable incident response playbooks for security teams.
ideas.title: SentinelLog: Cloud Security Threat Correlator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the Security track with a practical, high-utility operational tool that enterprise judges immediately understand.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage assistant that extracts basic vitals and processes voice-based symptom descriptions in multiple regional languages to prioritize patient queues.
ideas.title: MediTriage: Multilingual Vital Signs Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines healthcare utility with multilingual accessibility, a proven combination that wins hackathons focused on real-world medical impact.
